programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: A young woman looks to settle down into adult life with a house in the Cleveland suburbs; her twin sister will be renting from her, and she thinks they should find a fun and exciting condo downtown.

programs.title: Renovation Resort
programs.desc: To complete their lake houses, the teams take on the biggest task yet: the living room & and deck; these expansive spaces must flow together seamlessly, bringing the indoors out and the outdoors in to create a true lakefront oasis; with the finish line in sight, the pressure is higher than ever, and just when they think they've got it handled, Scott & Bryan introduce a surprise extra space that no one saw coming.

programs.title: Love It or List It
programs.desc: Despite its sentimental value, a blended family with three young children is in a home that's too cramped; with improvements, she thinks it could be their forever home, but David shows them a spectacular house that ticks all the boxes.

programs.title: Home Town
programs.desc: A family moves to Laurel, Miss., to escape cold Canadian winters, and are looking for big rooms and plenty of outdoor space for four boys; Ben and Erin present a rural bungalow on a huge piece of land and a home with a backyard bonus feature.

programs.title: Home Town
programs.desc: Jones College has a special place in Ben and Erin's hearts; they are asked to restore The Old President's House; it's a team effort as students, past and present, step in to help make this house feel less institutional and more like a home.

programs.title: Home Town
programs.desc: Erin's favorite odd couple, an aunt and her great niece, look for their mutual dream home, but they don't agree on anything; Ben and Erin show them two homes; Erin has her work cut out for her determining the color story for this contrary pair.
